data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.llm_hass_api: **Device control** gives access to entities exposed to voice assistants and works on physical voice satellites (`ESP32-S3-Box-3`, `Voice PE`, `Wyoming`). ⚠️ **Home Assistant** is restricted by HA Core to **logged-in admins in browser/app only** — do NOT select it on agents assigned to voice satellites (otherwise satellite requests fail with `Unauthorized`). Clear all selections for pure VK / Telegram chatbots.
data_description.web_search: Allows the agent to search the internet via Yandex Search (`search-api.webSearch.user` role). **Token & cost impact:** adds ~100 input tokens per turn for the tool schema; when triggered, performs a paid search (~0.40 RUB) + a 2nd LLM pass with found web pages (+500–2000 tokens). Keep **Off** on smart-home control agents (with large entity lists) and turn **On** on a separate VK / Telegram bot agent.
data_description.streaming: Streams text chunks in real time so Assist starts TTS voice playback immediately (~0.5–1s instead of waiting for the full text). **Does NOT increase token usage or billing cost.**
data_description.reasoning_effort: Depth of internal chain-of-thought reasoning before answering (`Qwen3` and latest Yandex models). **Token impact:** hidden reasoning thoughts are billed as output tokens (`completion_tokens`) and can increase token usage 2–5x.
